title: Dailybot | Check-ins, Analytics & Gmail - Dailybot's Freshest Upgrades! · Changelog
summary: Updated Check-ins home, deeper analytics, Gmail user support, and improved check-in creation flow for seamless team management.
body_markdown: We’ve shipped a fresh set of upgrades. The updated Check-ins home gives you a better overview of pending and completed check-ins. Deeper analytics help you understand participation and engagement. Gmail user support means more teams can join. And the improved check-in creation flow makes it easier to set up and manage your team rituals.
